limits: User identifies opening as handling noise and breathing after about 10s. RMS locates sound envelopes, not physiological inhale/exhale identity. Natural-speed cuts; no stretch, no claim of listening.

final_selection.phase_identity_source: User listening feedback; not inferred from RMS
final_selection.processing: Inhale: 75% speed, 3s -> 4s. Exhale: 71% speed, 3.55s -> 5s, then 1s silence. Both: slightly lowered pitch, source-edge fades and AAC compression.
